framing: Identical task, model, and prompt across conditions; only the input representation (IR JSON vs RTF-extracted text) varies.

task1_demographics_numeric_extraction_re.metric: fraction of 55 pre-registered ground-truth numeric values reproduced in the response (tolerance 0.05)
task1_demographics_numeric_extraction_re.ground_truth_source: ai_experiment/inputs/ir_demographics_sample.json (distinct numeric tokens across cell_value and cell_formatted)

task2_anomaly_detection_concept_recall.metric: fraction of a pre-registered set of 5 clinical concepts identified in the response
preregistered_concepts: high overall AE burden in the high-dose arm

rtf.concept_missed: high overall AE burden in the high-dose arm

notes: The original 2026-04-24 feasibility demonstration ran the IR condition only, at the API-default temperature.
Task 2 RTF condition used the AE-by-SOC/PT table (inputs/rtf_ae-by-soc_extracted.txt).
Verbatim responses are archived under responses/; see SCORING.md for the full worksheet.
